no_anchor_lies_in_gravity_sample.detail: gravity_eligible:false is asserted here by construction (every anchor cell, including bra->kor, is marked ineligible). Read-only inspection (git show, not merged onto this branch) of a CONCURRENT, unrelated task on origin/production/fullA-exact (commits 59f837b/9130967, 'Brazil-Korea gravity-exclusion task') confirms the exact needed primitive already exists there: `gravity_sample_mask(D, Ddest; exclude_diagonal::Bool, exclude_cells::Vector{Tuple{Int,Int}})` in full_aod_diag/gravity_tariff.jl, which masks q_tilde to zero for excluded cells (so they are never gravity-pivot-eligible and never contribute to the gravity constraint) -- `exclude_diagonal=true` covers every own-cell anchor, `exclude_cells=[(bra_idx,kor_idx)]` covers the Korea anchor. THIS IS THE EXACT SHAPE OF PRIMITIVE THIS TASK NEEDS and should be reused verbatim rather than re-implemented once available on a base this branch actually merges. It was intentionally NOT pulled into this branch's base (see master report: user directed 'ignore' that concurrent task since it was mid-fix at task-start time) -- so as of this manifest, the mask is confirmed to exist in the ecosystem but is NOT wired into this branch. Still requires: (a) confirming that branch's mask is stable/correct (not independently re-verified here), (b) merging or re-implementing it here, (c) cross-checking gravity_elimination.jl's pivot selection actually consumes the masked q_tilde (not just precompute_q_tilde/gravity_value) before this checklist item can flip to pass.
